# L’Ayalga

> Sign in with Google to find a published household by name, compare available stays and send the hosts an exact request. One host confirms the booking. A private invitation also opens the existing invited-guest flow.

This index links to public Markdown on the repository's production branch, main.
The guides distinguish implementation, local scripted tests, dated deployment
evidence, and remaining limitations. L’Ayalga began as an AWS Agents for Humans
hackathon entry; judging closed on 2026-10-14, and the submission material is
archived. The archive describes the hackathon demo, not current behavior.

## Product

- [Product overview and local setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juan294/layalga/main/README.md): Audience, behavior, setup, and disclosure.
- [Host manual](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juan294/layalga/main/docs/guides/host-manual.md): Google sign-in, adding hosts and rooms, decisions, follow-up, and recovery.
- [Guest manual](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juan294/layalga/main/docs/guides/guest-manual.md): Signed-in household search, conversational availability, room choice, private request status, invitations, reminders, changes and cancellation.
- [Roadmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juan294/layalga/main/docs/roadmap.md): Released work, the real-use launch, and remaining work.

An agent can introduce L’Ayalga before sign-in. To begin booking, open https://layalga.thecreativetoken.com/en/stays or https://layalga.thecreativetoken.com/es/stays and let the guest complete Google sign-in. Household lookup, availability and request preparation require a verified session. A compatible browser agent uses WebMCP on the signed-in page. The guest sends the request and can then check its outcome. A standalone ChatGPT or Claude integration requires delegated account linking.
